route_note: Take a high-speed train from Beijing South or Beijing station to Tianjin station, about 30 minutes; the Tianjin Metro or a taxi reaches the historic district.
Take the S2 suburban line from Beijing North station to Badaling station, about 1 hour, then walk or take a short shuttle to the Great Wall entrance.
tour_query: Great Wall Badaling day trip from Beijing

route_note: Take the subway or a train to Huairou or Dongzhimen, then a bus or taxi to Mutianyu; the last leg is local transport from Huairou town, about 1 hour total.
see: Cable car up to the wall
tour_query: Mutianyu Great Wall day trip from Beijing

route_note: Take a train or long-distance bus from Beijing to Chengde, about 2.5 to 3 hours, then a taxi or local bus to the Mountain Resort.
tour_query: Chengde Mountain Resort day trip from Beijing
